author: Alcock, 1890

note.en: A small deepwater lanternfish relative of 400 to 1830 m, known here only from a deep record.
note.es: Un pequeño pariente de peces linterna de aguas profundas, de 400 a 1830 m, conocido aquí solo por un registro profundo.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; deepwater species, no local record.
